Answer: C
Reason: The frontal and lateral chest X-rays demonstrate an opacity in the right upper lobe that respects the horizontal fissure (seen clearly on the lateral view) and contains air bronchograms. This combination of findings, particularly in a patient with this presentation, is highly suggestive of a neoplastic process such as adenocarcinoma (specifically the lepidic or pneumonic subtype), which can mimic pneumonia but typically does not resolve with antibiotics.
